templates.html:
{{title}}

Scroll down inside this box. The header above uses position: sticky with top: 0, so it stays pinned to the top of this scroll container instead of scrolling away with the text.

It only sticks within its own scrolling ancestor — once that ancestor ends, the header scrolls away too.

A third paragraph adds enough height to make scrolling necessary.

A fourth paragraph, for good measure.

And a fifth, so the sticky behaviour is unmistakable.
